ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel dominance (dark grey/black) with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips, resulting in a very low macro-level ratio of approximately 0.05 white to black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs localized at the extreme left and right distal tips. Sparse, low-contrast greyish mottling and faint linear streaks present in the upper-medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with approximately 45-degree interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge, with increased irregularity localized near the median notch and distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer edges, sweeping outward and upward from the peduncle to defined distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the outer distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically and diagonally across the upper-mid regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring/barnacle clusters on the distal tips; irregular trailing edge geometry suggesting historical minor tissue loss.
